slides.text: My grandfather's watch stopped at 4:17. He never let anyone fix it.
"Your watch is wrong, thatha." He'd smile. "No. It's right."
After he passed, we found an old letter in his drawer.
1971. A railway station. A coach on fire. He pulled twelve people out.
The letter ended: "You saved us at 4:17. We will never forget." He never told anyone. He just kept the time.
Who's the quiet hero in your family?
